propositions: The code-v3 impact model discards verifier-supplied prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields for maint-lane findings, preventing consequential test-sufficiency findings from blocking even when guarded paths have high user reach.

A contract-assertion contradiction (commit 8eadb4fbc5: contract allows stale>0, test asserts stale=0) escaped code review because the tests litmus refactor antipattern matched no stale assertion-breaking improvement, and maint-lane churn dampening (×0.5 when churn absent) compressed priority to ~0.30 below the advisory@0.95 threshold.

Code-v4 must introduce forbids_contract_allowed_state as a serious maint binary (×1.0 undamped), re-scope prod_impact/trigger_likelihood descriptions to rate guarded-path reach for coverage/contract findings, split moderate-maint via prod_impact multipliers (high/med=1.0, low=0.6, none=0.5), restrict reversibility floor to consequence lanes, and make debt binaries churn-amplifier-only (1.0 to 1.5), enabling tests@0.54 blocking.

Replay on code-v3 corpus (1881 sidecars, 1243 changes, 3384 findings) shows v3 blocks 42 changes (3.4%); v4+tests@0.54 blocks 99 (8.0%, operator-accepted); zero demotions of currently-blocking findings; stored code-v3 sidecars remain version-gated and unmodified.

High/NIT median separation (0.90 vs 0.24, delta 0.66) must hold under v4 over code_review_impact_labels.jsonl; NIT median must remain <0.30 despite cold-debt amplifier increase (0.12→0.24); absent binary contributes 0.

Blocking-set version pins and test premises must be updated across test_impact_model_versioning.py (2 equality sites), test_code_review_ws2.py (1 pin), test_impact_code.py (deleted churn-scale test, re-targeted freq_mult to debt, inverted floor case), and acceptance verified end-to-end on fire case (forbids_contract_allowed_state with prod_impact ≠ none) and pass cases (stated tightening; pure-function exact-value assert).
